Subject: Onsite demo + SF exec dinner — proposed dates (June 24-26)

Hi Samantha / Jake —

Great to connect last week. As discussed, we’d love to schedule an onsite deep-dive demo at FastScale’s SF office. Proposed dates when the AE + SE + execs are available on our side:

- Wed, June 24
- Thu, June 25
- Fri, June 26

Planned attendees: Markus Klein (AE, Redwood), Ben Carter (SE, Redwood), Laura Bennett (Head of Product, Redwood); your platform and infra engineers for the hands-on portion (you mentioned Samantha and Jake).

Suggested agenda (attached: redwood_demo_agenda_v1.pdf):
- 10:00–11:15 Deep-dive architecture + live inference walkthrough
- 11:15–12:00 Q&A and integration discussion
- 12:00–13:00 Lunch (on us)
- Afternoon optional session with engineering for procurement/security checklist

We’re also planning an executive dinner in SF on the evening of the first day (June 24) — casual spot for your leadership + our execs to meet. If you’re not local, we can move the dinner to whichever day works best.

Can you confirm which dates work for your team? If none of these are possible, please propose alternatives (we’re flexible). Also looping Ben and Laura for SE availability and to confirm any logistics/security requirements.

Thanks — look forward to hosting you in SF.

Best,
Markus Klein
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood_demo_agenda_v1.pdf, SSO_questionnaire.xlsx

Markus — thanks for the note and the agenda. Quick update from our side: several of our infra/platform engineers (including Jake) will be at KubeCon on June 24–25 and won’t be available for onsite meetings those days.

We can do Friday, June 26 for the onsite demo (team will be back in SF), or the following week (July 1–2) if that’s easier.

A couple of asks up front:
- Procurement would like to review a sample PO and basic commercial terms before we lock travel — looping procurement@fastscale.com on this thread.
- Our security team wants a SOC2 and a short SSO questionnaire answered ahead of any on-site access. I see you attached an SSO questionnaire — can that be filled out?

About the exec dinner: if you can move it to Friday night (June 26) that would work better since many of our folks will be traveling on Thu.

Thanks — pls confirm June 26 availability and send any procurement docs you have.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Director of Platform Engineering, FastScale
Samantha.Lee@fastscale.com
